articles.summary: Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—will host a Grand Opening celebration at Mirabella, its newest West Houston community, on Saturday, September 12 from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. The tailgate-themed event in Brookshire will welcome visitors for burgers, yard games and face painting as they tour two fully furnished new model homes and explore available homes. New homes at the Italian-inspired community are now selling from the low $200s across two floor plan collections. Learn more, explore available homes and RSVP for the Grand Opening at www.CenturyCommunities.com/MirabellaGO . "We're excited to introduce Mirabella as the latest addition to our new home lineup in the fast-growing West Houston corridor," said Division President Tanya Rizzo. articles.title: Century Communities to Celebrate September Grand Opening at Mirabella, an Italian-Inspired New Home Community in Brookshire, TX, Near Katy
